::: {.why}
The year exists in eleven separate reports and nobody will read eleven, so the dossier is the one document that has to stand alone and it is built from your eleven sentences.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Produce a single document covering the platform, the alpha book, the risk model, the execution study and the live record.
- Have every claim in it traceable to a milestone and reproducible from committed code.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Write the dossier around the eleven sentences: one section per theme rather than per milestone, with the strongest figure from each and a pointer to the full report. The platform, the noise floor, the alpha book, the risk model, the execution study and the live record are six sections, and the machine learning audit belongs inside the alpha book section rather than beside it.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Verify traceability: every number in the dossier gets a reference to the milestone and the configuration that produced it. Then pick three at random and reproduce them from a clean checkout. Anything that fails is a claim to remove rather than a bug to note.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
The research dossier pulls the year into one document with every claim traced to a milestone and a configuration, verified by reproducing three claims at random from a clean checkout.
:::
